CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dmf_finish_notification(p_id uuid, p_attempt_token uuid, p_status text, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
if p_status not in ('sent','failed','skipped') or length(coalesce(p_error,''))>100 then raise exception 'Invalid delivery result' using errcode='22023';end if;
update public.notification_deliveries set status=p_status,last_error=p_error,lease_until=null,sent_at=case when p_status='sent' then now() else sent_at end,updated_at=now() where id=p_id and attempt_token=p_attempt_token and status='sending';return found;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dmf_save_chat(p_session_id text, p_owner_token text, p_messages jsonb, p_lead_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare saved_id uuid; token_hash text;
begin
  if p_session_id is null or length(p_session_id) not between 1 and 200
     or p_owner_token is null or p_owner_token !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
     or p_messages is null or jsonb_typeof(p_messages) <> 'array'
     or jsonb_array_length(p_messages) > 200 or octet_length(p_messages::text) > 1000000
     or p_lead_data is null or jsonb_typeof(p_lead_data) <> 'object'
     or octet_length(p_lead_data::text) > 10000 then
    raise exception 'Invalid chat input' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  token_hash := encode(sha256(convert_to(p_owner_token, 'UTF8')), 'hex');
  insert into public.chat_sessions (session_id, owner_token_hash, messages, message_count, lead_email, lead_company, lead_phone, lead_interest, updated_at)
  values (p_session_id, token_hash, p_messages, jsonb_array_length(p_messages), nullif(p_lead_data->>'email', ''), nullif(p_lead_data->>'company', ''), nullif(p_lead_data->>'phone', ''), nullif(p_lead_data->>'interest', ''), now())
  on conflict (session_id) do update set
    messages = excluded.messages, message_count = excluded.message_count,
    lead_email = coalesce(excluded.lead_email, chat_sessions.lead_email),
    lead_company = coalesce(excluded.lead_company, chat_sessions.lead_company),
    lead_phone = coalesce(excluded.lead_phone, chat_sessions.lead_phone),
    lead_interest = coalesce(excluded.lead_interest, chat_sessions.lead_interest), updated_at = now()
  where chat_sessions.owner_token_hash = token_hash returning id into saved_id;
  return saved_id is not null;
end; $function$
functions.name: dmf_save_chat

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dmf_submit_lead(p_lead jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_lead is null or jsonb_typeof(p_lead) <> 'object' or octet_length(p_lead::text) > 10000 or nullif(btrim(p_lead->>'email'), '') is null or length(p_lead->>'email') > 320 then
    raise exception 'Invalid lead input' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  insert into public.leads (email, company, phone, interest, session_id, source, status)
  values (btrim(p_lead->>'email'), p_lead->>'company', p_lead->>'phone', p_lead->>'interest', p_lead->>'sessionId', coalesce(p_lead->>'source', 'website'), 'new') on conflict do nothing;
  return true;
end; $function$
functions.name: dmf_submit_lead

tables.view_definition:
SELECT inbox.id,
    inbox.source,
    inbox.kind,
    inbox.contact_name,
    inbox.email,
    inbox.phone,
    inbox.company,
    inbox.message,
    inbox.status,
    inbox.stage,
    inbox.candidate_id,
    inbox.candidate_code,
    inbox.service,
    inbox.headcount,
    inbox.work_location,
    inbox.start_window,
    inbox.source_path,
    inbox.campaign,
    inbox.assigned_to,
    inbox.follow_up_on,
    inbox.next_action,
    inbox.notes,
    inbox.workflow_version,
    inbox.created_at,
    inbox.updated_at,
    COALESCE(receipt.id, inbox.id) AS reference,
    concat_ws(' '::text, inbox.contact_name, inbox.email, inbox.company, inbox.candidate_code, inbox.id, receipt.id) AS search_text
   FROM ( SELECT inquiries.id,
            'inquiry'::text AS source,
            COALESCE(inquiries.request_purpose, inquiries.type, 'contact'::text) AS kind,
            inquiries.client_name AS contact_name,
            inquiries.email,
            inquiries.phone,
            inquiries.company,
            inquiries.message,
            inquiries.status,
                CASE inquiries.status
                    WHEN 'new'::text THEN 'new'::text
                    WHEN 'completed'::text THEN 'closed'::text
                    ELSE 'active'::text
                END AS stage,
            inquiries.candidate_id,
            inquiries.candidate_code,
            inquiries.service,
            inquiries.headcount,
            inquiries.work_location,
            inquiries.start_window,
            inquiries.source_path,
            inquiries.campaign,
            inquiries.assigned_to,
            inquiries.follow_up_on,
            inquiries.next_action,
            inquiries.notes,
            inquiries.workflow_version,
            inquiries.created_at,
            inquiries.updated_at
           FROM inquiries
        UNION ALL
         SELECT leads.id,
            'lead'::text,
            'lead'::text,
            NULL::text AS text,
            leads.email,
            leads.phone,
            leads.company,
            leads.interest,
            leads.status,
                CASE leads.status
                    WHEN 'new'::text THEN 'new'::text
                    WHEN 'converted'::text THEN 'closed'::text
                    WHEN 'lost'::text THEN 'closed'::text
                    ELSE 'active'::text
                END AS "case",
            NULL::uuid AS uuid,
            NULL::text AS text,
            NULL::text AS text,
            NULL::integer AS int4,
            NULL::text AS text,
            NULL::text AS text,
            leads.source_path,
            leads.campaign,
            leads.assigned_to,
            leads.follow_up_on,
            leads.next_action,
            leads.notes,
            leads.workflow_version,
            leads.created_at,
            leads.updated_at
           FROM leads) inbox
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.id
           FROM intake_submissions s
          WHERE s.record_id = inbox.id AND (inbox.source = 'lead'::text AND s.kind = 'lead'::text OR inbox.source = 'inquiry'::text AND (s.kind = ANY (ARRAY['contact'::text, 'profile'::text])))
          ORDER BY s.created_at, s.id
         LIMIT 1) receipt ON true;
